name: 44176-prefillheavy-27b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B -- 55.56 GB of bf16 safetensors, which fit one 80 GB card.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens (min = max on both), prompts drawn independently with no shared prefix, seed static 42. The `vllm_python` backend renders each row as a chat message, so the engine's own prompt count reads a handful above 1024, and it sets ignore_eos, so every request emits all 128.
purpose: A 27B-parameter document summarizer condensing page-long inputs into short briefs for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: one GPU serving a 27B hybrid checkpoint text-only under a
# saturated closed loop of 1024-in / 128-out requests. The engine is a source checkout at
# dc10e467a9859f220ba9d36c31c50fb22bc38373; the interpreter and the hardware seal are in
# configs/env.yaml, which is per-machine.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B

language-model-only: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# HAZARD, which is why it is pinned: driven in process the engine falls through to a class
# default of 2048 instead, which is a materially different operating point, at rc=0.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

# A memory bound, not a policy: each in-flight sequence carries ~148 MiB of fp32 recurrent
# state across the 48 linear-attention layers, so the default of 1024 seats does not fit.
max-num-seqs: 64

max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
